messages.author: d42e88b7645d03c8
messages.subject: Re: issue about tree plot (Tree package)
parts:
Hi CY,

Please try:

# title: annotation in tree plot
# date: 2014.10.10
library(tree)
data(cpus, package="MASS")
cpus.ltr <- tree(log10(perf) ~ ., data = cpus[, 2:8])
cpus.ltr
plot(cpus.ltr, type="u")
text(cpus.ltr)
title("Classification with TREE")
# end
